Non-Harvard students please use the button below for the Harvard cross-registration process.

Tufts (Fletcher and Friedman students)/Brown/MGH students please use the button above for the Harvard cross-registration process.

After completing the registration form you will receive an email with a link to validate your identity .

Even if you already have a Harvard ID and Key, please complete the registration form. Once identity validation is complete, you will receive an email with your Harvard ID and instructions on how to claim your HarvardKey. You can then login to my.harvard to petition Harvard courses.
